content_sections.text: Other conditions: Selected candidate must be present at the university from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Selected candidate must not take any other part-time or full-time employment Desirable: Candidates with a proven track record in research, as per the prevailing regulatory authority's guidelines, may be given priority

content_sections.text: Candidates whose applications are incomplete will not be considered Candidates who canvass directly or indirectly will be disqualified

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Specialization: British and American Literatures / New Literatures in English / ELT & Applied Linguistics / Translation Studies / Marginal Literature / Travel Writing. Pay: Rs. 40,000 per month (consolidated). Qualification required: Microbiology (M.Sc, Ph.D./GSET/NET); Botany (M.Sc, Ph.D./GSET/NET). Pay: Rs. 40,000 per month (consolidated).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 40,000/- per month, or an amount finalized as per the decision of the university authorities. Purely temporary contract for 11 months, up to the end of the second term of Academic Year 2026-27, or until a regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier Appointment ends automatically at the end of the contract without notice Performance reviewed after six months Selected candidate signs an agreement on stamp paper of Rs. 300/- at own expense Provident fund, gratuity, leave travel concession and medical benefits are not admissible

rows.event: Last date for online application (6:10 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will VNSGU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview at the university with original document verification Walk-in interview on the date shown for the department Original documents are verified at the interview Selection Committee may fill the post with a specialization if necessary Candidates from allied or relevant specializations may be considered if no suitable candidate is found, after verification and scrutiny

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Online-filled application form, two sets Self-attested copies of documents needed for the eligibility criteria Filled score card CGPA to percentage conversion table, if mark sheets carry CGPA Original documents for verification

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VNSGU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online by 26-11-2026, 6:10 PM; detailed information is on www.vnsgu.ac.in and http://vnsgurec.samarth.edu.in/. Download the online-filled application form and bring it in two sets. Attach self-attested copies of the documents needed for the eligibility criteria and the filled score card. Attend the walk-in interview at the venue on the date shown for the department, reporting one hour before the time shown. Bring original documents for verification.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Qualifications, experience, publications or honours obtained after the application deadline and before the interview date will not be considered Any corrigendum or addendum will be uploaded only on the VNSGU website The university may change the specialization, category and number of seats
